placeholderNotice: Template preview: graphs, animations and target nodes are placeholders from the earlier advisor demo.
graphFamiliesNote: Graphs in the same family share a start drawing; they are never shown back to back within a section and never reuse target nodes.

part1.title: Part 1 · Match nodes in static drawings
part1.instruction: Select the nodes in the right drawing that match the highlighted nodes in the left drawing.
part1.targetsNote: Placeholder: 4 nodes spread across the drawing, at least 3 edges apart. Same targets for ARCOL and DARCOL of a graph so the two methods are compared on identical tasks.

part2.title: Part 2 · Track nodes through an animation
part2.instruction: Memorize the highlighted nodes, watch the graph change, then select the same nodes in the final drawing.

region.label: Highlighted graph region
region.intro: In this section, a group of nodes in one region of the graph is highlighted. Keep track of them while the graph changes.
region.targetsNote: Placeholder: 4 nodes within one area of the drawing, at least 3 edges apart (no neighbours or siblings).

moved.label: Nodes moved for the aspect-ratio change
moved.intro: In this section, the highlighted nodes are ones the layout moves to fit the new shape. Keep track of them while the graph changes.
moved.targetsNote: Placeholder: 4 of the most-displaced nodes (start vs DARCOL drawing), at least 3 edges apart. Replace with the structures DARCOL actually moved.
